exposure: Maternal urinary Bisphenol A (BPA) levels during late pregnancy
Tertiles of maternal urinary BPA concentrations
outcome: Child cognitive development at age 2 years, assessed using the Ages & Stages Questionnaires, Third Edition (ASQ-3)
cohort: 215 mother-child pairs from a birth cohort in Shanghai
finding: High maternal urinary BPA concentrations during late pregnancy were associated with lower scores in gross motor and problem-solving domains in girls only.
